name: Insomnia
source:
The protagonist suffers from insomnia and narcolepsy. And so, when everyone else is already fast asleep, our pioneer is forced to wander the camp out of boredom, fulfilling the duties of a camp counselor's assistant. But, as it turns out, he isn't the only one awake tonight...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2961300782]Steam[/url]]
